frame: mount is cart base_link <- the URDF's base_link (origin on the arm base's bottom face, 3.9 cm behind the shoulder_pan axis; +x is where the arm reaches at its zero pose); links are boxes in each link's own URDF frame, metres and degrees (rpy as URDF writes it)

mount.note: FITTED 2026-10-04 to the head's own depth, not taped (scratch/arm_mount/: grids.py, fast.py, final_fit.py, project.py). Data: scratch/body_fit's two captures of 2026-10-02 23:46-00:02 (7 head poses, 8 depth frames each, base_link by TF; the arm parked as joints.pose_deg was read at 23:20), as 5 mm voxels hit and voxels seen free (rays from the modelled left eye, stopped 1.5 cm short of their points). Method: the folded arm at joints.pose_deg through the URDF and these boxes; score = the arm's 2989 voxels (z > 0.83 m, right of the speaker box) inside the boxes grown 1 cm, minus 0.5 x the seen-free voxels inside the boxes shrunk 1 cm; FFT over 5 mm translations for every 5 deg of yaw, then Nelder-Mead. Residual: of the arm's voxels 45 % inside the bare boxes, 82 % within 1 cm, 98.6 % within margin_m; outside distance rms 8.9 mm, p90 15 mm, p99 32 mm (servo wires); 15 % of the shrunk boxes' volume seen free (the boxes are hulls and hold air); the model's top 0.937 m against the arm's highest points 0.936. Uncertainty: x +-8 mm, y +-10 mm, z +-8 mm, yaw +-5 deg. The two captures alone agree within 2/3/0/1; the score weights, box tolerances and height cut move it -6..+3 / -5..+5 / -4..+8 mm / -1.5..+1.4 deg; dropping one head pose moves y up to +13 mm (without pan -90) and yaw -8.6 deg (without pan 0); profiles lose 1 % of the score within -5..+2.5 / +-2.5 / -2.5..+7.5 mm / -2.5..+5 deg; the neck model adds ~6 mm. Heading: depth alone scores the arm folded backward (yaw 153, base over the front edge) within 4 %; the snapshots refute it (the boxes projected into snap_m90_t63 put the gripper at the front, where it is). Prior: XLeRobot's published geometry for its right arm (xlerobot_front.urdf: the base square to the top basket, the pan axis 3.9 cm behind the front wall and 6.1 cm in from the right wall, the base's bottom 1.5 cm under the rim) on this basket gives (-0.065, -0.133, 0.765, 0 deg), +-3/2/2 cm and 10 deg; the fit's pan axis (-0.026, -0.140) is within 1 cm of the prior's (-0.027, -0.133) and its base 1.5 cm higher. YAW CARRIES THE SHOULDER_PAN ZERO: only the base box tells the mount's yaw from the pan's zero, and it prefers the base square to the cart (yaw_deg 0, x_m -0.063, y_m -0.140, z_m 0.779) with shoulder_pan 20 deg further left than read (-7.6, not -27.6): score +6 %, seen-free share 12 % against 15 %. This block is the fit with the joints as read, so the parked mask and an /arm/joint_states in the same calibration pose the moving links right; the square variant goes in together with a pan zero corrected by +20 deg. Check by tape: the shoulder_pan horn's centre (first servo, from above) at x -0.025, y -0.140 (5.2 cm behind the cart's front plane), the base's bottom face 0.78 m up.

joints.note: pose_deg is the arm as it stands parked, READ 2026-10-02 23:20 through the base server's registers request (scratch/arm_mask/read_arm.py; torque off on all six): the servos' EEPROM carries the lerobot calibration of 2026-08-30 to the tick (homing offsets and position limits = ~/.cache/huggingface/lerobot/calibration/robots/so_follower/pepin_follower.json), and the URDF's 'new calib' zero is the middle of each calibrated range, lerobot's DEGREES convention: angle = (ticks - (range_min + range_max) / 2) * 360 / 4096. The gripper is lerobot's linear 0-100 joint, here (ticks - range_min) * 360 / 4096 - 10 deg onto the URDF's -10..100. The signs are lerobot's = the URDF's, NOT verified by a move: with them the parked arm stands folded on its base (scratch/arm_mask/folded_pose.py; shoulder_lift and elbow_flex sit at a stop each, the URDF's limits), with shoulder_lift or elbow_flex flipped it would reach 11 cm under its own base. shoulder_pan's zero is the least sure: its calibrated range is 174 deg against the URDF's 220, so its middle may sit up to ~23 deg off. source topic reads /arm/joint_states (sensor_msgs/JointState, these joint names, radians, URDF convention, stamped at the encoder read) and falls back to pose_deg when no sample lies within max_age_s of a frame.

links_source: scripts/arm_boxes.py: the tightest box along each link's own axes (or its vertices' principal axes, whichever is smaller; never smaller here), cut in two across the longest side where that saves a quarter of the volume, fitted to the visual meshes of TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 at 5f6d2b8 (Apache-2.0), exact hulls; margin_m grows every box at run time. scripts/arm_boxes.py --check compares this block with the meshes.
note: The robot's own arm for the camera's self-filter (pepin.arm; depth_fusion's arm_filter flag): its links posed by forward kinematics of the vendored URDF (pepin/vendor/so101), every box grown by margin_m; a depth pixel whose ray enters a grown box writes nothing on or past that point, and every voxel inside a grown box is forgotten after each integration. Read live: an edit of this file reaches the next frame. depth_fusion publishes the grown boxes on /fusion/arm (visualization_msgs/MarkerArray, base_link) whether or not the flag is on: the check is the arm's points inside them in Foxglove.
